newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Qingdao Doublestar sets targets for 2000.
newsitem.headline: China's Qingdao Doublestar sets targets for 2000.

text.p: China's Qingdao Doublestar Group, parent of Qingdao Doublestar Shoes Manufacturing Co Ltd, expects sales of 5.0 billion yuan ($600 million) in the year 2000, the China Chemical Industry News said on Friday.
The group was forecast to produce 100 million pairs of shoes and set up 2,000 chain stores across the country by 2000, the newspaper said. It gave no comparative figures.

Last year, the group's sales topped 2.0 billion yuan for the first time ever, it said, adding that the group has been China's top shoemaker for the past five years, with a 14 percent market share last year.
Qingdao Doublestar now has 600 chain stores.
The newspaper gave no further details.
